claims.text: The Senate's own open-data record for RQS 193/2022 (Código 152222, processo 8224484) gives the ementa verbatim as 'Sessão especial destinada a comemorar os 75 anos do Dia Mundial da Ufologia' and the date as 16 March 2022. The instrument is a request for a commemorative special session, not a records-seeking one, confirmed from the Senate's own data service rather than from secondary description.

b.label: National Archives Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Records Collection

edges.label: COMPARISON: a voluntary military transfer into a civil archive versus a statutory collection ordered by Congress
edges.note: COMPARISON EDGE — no institutional contact between the Arquivo Nacional and NARA is claimed or evidenced. Brazil: from 2007 the Comando da Aeronáutica began sending its holdings to the Arquivo Nacional of its own motion, producing the Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado – OVNI (BR DFANBSB ARX), 743 registros, served online, with the service publicly disclaiming further competence. The United States: the UAP Records Collection in Record Group 615 exists only because sections 1841–1843 of Public Law 118-31 ordered it into being, with a statutory transfer deadline and with the independent review board stripped out in conference. Same archival endpoint, opposite mechanism — one service handed its record over, the other had to be legislated at. [CORRECTED 14 Aug 2026: RQS 193/2022 is a request for a COMMEMORATIVE SPECIAL SESSION under Art. 199 RISF, approved 16 Mar 2022, held 24 Jun 2022 - not a records-seeking or compelling instrument. Its durable value is the content of its justificacao, which names Operacao Prato, the 1986 night, SIOANI and the archive reference BR DFANBSB ARX. These edges assert what the document NAMES, which is verifiable in its text and unaffected by its procedural nature, so the tier is unchanged. Any claim that the instrument COMPELLED disclosure would be false.]

edges.label: The UFO fund is held in Brasília and its reference code says so
edges.note: The Arquivo Nacional's own notice identifies the holding as 'o Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado – OVNI (BR DFANBSB ARX)', produced by the Comando da Aeronáutica and held by the Arquivo Nacional, comprising 743 registros. DFANBSB is the archival code for the Arquivo Nacional's Brasília unit. RQS 193/2022 states the transfer route directly: 'A partir de 2007, a Aeronáutica, mas não o Exército e nem a Marinha, passou a enviar seus papeis resultantes de suas pesquisas para o Arquivo Nacional, em Brasília.' edges.label: The Brazilian Air Force mounted Operação Prato as its own field operation
edges.note: Operação Prato was run by the Força Aérea Brasileira out of the Belém air base in Pará, with the SNI, after mayors in the Colares area formally asked for help. The Brazilian Senate's own Requerimento 193/2022 lists it among the official Aeronáutica UAP programmes: 'Desde 1954, o Governo Brasileiro, por meio de sua Aeronáutica, já criou vários programas oficiais de pesquisas dos OVNIs, como em 1977, quando ocorreu a chamada Operação Prato'. Bob Pratt's file records that the operation was staffed by 'Captain Uyrangê Hollanda and six sergeants' and was shut down after four months by Brigadier Protázio Lopes de Oliveira, the base commander in Belém. This is the base institutional fact the whole Brazilian cluster hangs from and it was previously unwired. b.label: SETKA-AN / SETKA-MO (later Galaktika, then Gorizont) - Soviet state anomalous phenomena programme

edges.label: COMPARISON: two military UAP field-collection programmes that ended in publication rather than burial
edges.note: COMPARISON EDGE — no contact between the Brazilian and Soviet programmes is claimed or evidenced, and none is likely. The pairing is structural: Operação Prato was a small dedicated Air Force and SNI field detachment run under a military dictatorship that closed with an official negative finding and whose files later went to a civil national archive; SETKA was a thirteen-year standing collection tasking laid on the whole Soviet armed forces, written up afterwards by the men who ran it and published in the Academy of Sciences' own journal. Both are counter-examples to the US pattern in the same way and by opposite routes — one through an archive law, one through its own operators publishing. edges.note: RQS 193/2022 credits Brazil as the first state to admit officially that the objects exist — the 1954 Escola Superior de Guerra meeting at which then-Captain João Adil de Oliveira spoke — lists SIOANI (1969, IV COMAR), Operação Prato (1977) and the 1986 night as official Aeronáutica programmes, and notes that the Aeronáutica 'sempre foi discreta quanto a estes e a outros fatos, mas nunca os negou quando inquirida'. b.label: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

edges.label: 2022 Senate special session justified by the 2021 US UAP report
edges.note: Requerimento RQS 193/2022 (Sen. Eduardo Girao and seven co-signers) requested the Brazilian Senate special session on ufology, and its justification expressly cites the 2021 'Pentagon' UAP report covering 144 sightings of which only one was explained, plus FY2022 NDAA UAP research funding. The report described is the June 2021 Preliminary Assessment authored by the UAP Task Force and released by ODNI. The session was held in the Senate plenary on 24 June 2022 and ended with ufologists handing Girao the 'Carta de Brasilia' urging a permanent joint civil-military commission.
